meta.name: DAGM. Y
meta.tagline: I enjoy working with businesses and creative individuals.
meta.aboutBio:
Hey, I am a WordPress developer with 3+ years building custom plugins, LMS platforms, membership systems, eCommerce stores, and sites that hold up after launch. I work with business owners who need WordPress done right the first time and maintained with the same standard after.   

Here is what that looks like in practice:  
A plugin your team actually needed, built from scratch because no off-the-shelf tool did it correctly. A LearnDash course platform that enrolls students, tracks progress, and handles payment without manual work. A site that loads fast, stays secure, and does not break when you update a plugin. A care plan that means someone with real expertise is watching your site every week, not just collecting a fee.  

My focus is clean builds, honest timelines, and sites that work the way your business needs them to.   

What I help with:  
- Custom WordPress Plugin Development  
- LearnDash LMS Builds and Customization  
- MemberPress and Membership System Setup  
- WooCommerce Development and Configuration  
- WordPress Web Design (Elementor, custom themes)  
- Website Care Plans and Ongoing Maintenance  
- Plugin Debugging and Conflict Resolution  
- Site Speed and Performance Optimization  
- WordPress Migration and Security Hardening  
- Gravity Forms, API Integrations, and Custom Workflows  

Tools and platforms I know well: WordPress, LearnDash, MemberPress, WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, Elementor, Advanced Custom Fields, PHP, MySQL, Divi, Gutenburg, Wp Page Bakery, REST API, Stripe, Zapier, Cloudflare.  

My approach is simple. I look at what your site needs to do for your business. Then I build it to do exactly that. No overcomplicated solutions. No disappearing after launch.   

If you need a plugin built, a course platform launched, or a developer who will actually keep your site healthy, send me a message.
meta.specialization: Specializing in fast, mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly websites that drive results.
